function.name: getjpx_for_helioviewer_v1
function.description:
This is the subfunction for tool "helioviewer_v1", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Generate and (optionally) download a custom JPX movie of the specified datasource.

        Either `sourceId` must be specified, or the combination of `observatory`, `instrument`, `detector`, and `measurement`."

starttime.description: Date/Time for the beginning of the JPX movie data. ISO 8601 combined UTC date and time UTC format.

endtime.description: Date/Time for the end of the JPX movie data.  ISO 8601 combined UTC date and time UTC format.

sourceid.description: Unique image datasource identifier.  Can be specified in lieu of the `observatory`, `instrument`, `detector`, and `measurement` parameters.

linked.description: Generate a `linked` JPX file containing image pointers instead of data for each individual frame in the series. Currently, only JPX image series support this feature.

verbose.description: If set to `true,` the JSON response will include timestamps for each frame in the resulting movie and any warning messages associated with the request, in addition to the JPX movie file URI.

jpip.description: Optionally return a JPIP URI string instead of the binary data of the movie itself, or instead of an HTTP URI in the JSON response (if `verbose` is set to `true`).

cadence.description:
The desired amount of time (in seconds) between each frame in the movie.

                If no cadence is specified, the server will attempt to select an optimal cadence.
